standard_prerequisites.name: Regular proper models of a curve, exceptional curves of the first kind and their contraction
standard_prerequisites.statement: A model of a smooth projective curve over the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring is a flat proper scheme over the ring with that curve as generic fibre; over a two-dimensional base such a scheme is projective once it is regular, and a projective scheme carries an ample invertible sheaf. An exceptional curve of the first kind is a smooth rational curve of self-intersection minus one inside the surface, and such a curve may be contracted to a regular projective surface, which decreases the number of irreducible components of the special fibre by exactly one. The author's own notions and the three results of the Resolution of Surfaces chapter and the one of More on Morphisms that the proof quotes are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the existence half of the theory of minimal models in this chapter: it produces a minimal model from any regular proper one, and the chapter's later results on uniqueness of minimal models take its conclusion as their starting point.

core_obligations: Obtain projectivity: the resolution theorem for regular two-dimensional schemes over the base makes the given regular proper model projective, hence it carries an ample invertible sheaf, which the author notes will be used below (source lines 4502-4505).

Perform one contraction: choose an exceptional curve of the first kind on the model, which the chapter's section on minus-one curves makes available, and contract it, obtaining a morphism to a model that is again regular and projective over the ring (source lines 4505-4512).

Count the effect of a contraction: the number of irreducible components of the special fibre of the contracted model is exactly one less than before, so the procedure can be repeated only finitely many times (source lines 4512-4514).
Conclude existence: the chain of contractions therefore terminates, and the model at which it stops is minimal, which is the asserted sequence of morphisms (source lines 4514-4516).

proof_roadmap.step: Projectivity of the regular proper model and the ample invertible sheaf it carries.
Choosing an exceptional curve of the first kind and contracting it, keeping regularity and projectivity.
Counting the drop in the number of components to get termination and read off the minimal model.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-pre-exists-minimal-model（源 4484-4499 行，证明 4501-4516 行）：设 C/K 光滑射影且 H^0(C,O_C)=K，若 X 是 C 的正则 proper 模型，则存在一串 proper 正则模型的收缩 X=X_m→…→X_0，每步收缩一条第一类例外曲线，且 X_0 是极小模型。关键操作不是例行核验：证明要先把「正则二维 ⇒ 射影」与「射影 ⇒ 有 ample 可逆层」两步接上（4502-4505 行），再挑一条第一类例外曲线并用可逆层把它**收缩**成仍是正则且射影的模型（4505-4512 行），最后必须**数出收缩使特殊纤维的不可约分支数恰好减一**，从而论证该过程只能进行有限次（4512-4516 行）。难点在于终止性论证依赖「分支数严格递减」这一计数事实，而每一步的合法性又依赖射影性（无射影性则收缩后的正则性/射影性不保）；原文位置在证明的 4502-4505、4505-4512、4512-4516 行。
